== Published English Original Virtual Set 2 wording ==
The later slip requires the armed Stormtrooper to be present at a site for the forfeit and destiny-draw bonuses. The early card only requires the Blaster Rifle for those effects. The independent weapon/battle destiny modifier stays at +2.
